Get EASL Players

Source: R/easl.R
easl_players.Rd

Every EASL player of all seasons; with season and team_id a roster that adds jersey number and position.

Endpoint: GET https://easl.joshricha.com/api/v1/players

Usage

easl_players(season = NULL, team_id = NULL)

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = EASL 25-26; the four editions are 2024 to 2027). The runtime reads easl_seasons and maps it to the DataCore seasonId. Default NULL: no season filter.

team_id

DataCore team (entity) UUID v1, e.g. '865489e8-b0f5-11ed-8b3f-c199a9dea184' (Utsunomiya Brex): the team_id of easl_teams, easl_standings and the box scores. easl_team resolves the 12 historical teams easl_teams does not list. Needs season for a roster (jersey number and position). Default NULL: no team filter.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Every EASL player of all seasons; with season and team_id a roster that adds jersey number and position. An empty answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py easl_players):

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year of the filter, from the request; null when no season was passed.
season_idcharacterDataCore season UUID v1 of the filter; null when no season was passed.
player_row_idintegerThe sync server's own integer row id of the player (not a DataCore id).
player_idcharacterplayerId: DataCore person UUID v1 (key space: EASL persons, the same id as the box score's personId; joins /players, leaders and play-by-play players). Not a team id.
namecharacterPlayer display name in 'FAMILY Given' form with the family name upper-cased (OSAKABE Taiki), in Latin script.
name_latincharacterAlternative name: equal to nameFullLocal for 257 of 552 players, otherwise null; never non-Latin in the observed data.
name_abbreviatedcharacterAbbreviated name; null for 551 of 552 players (one empty string).
nationalitycharacterISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the player's nationality; 36 codes occur, KOR 119, USA 102, JPN 81, PHL 80, TWN 61, CHN 22, MNG 16, HKG 15, MAC 13 ('PHI' also appears once, a non-ISO spelling of PHL).
gendercharacterMALE on all 552 rows.
dobDateDate of birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD' (a public biography field; 1980-10-05 to 2023-10-16 in the data, so the latest values are implausible); 5 players have none. Null on some rows.
height_cmintegerHeight in centimetres; 43 of 552 players have none. Null on some rows.
height_feetcharacterHeight in feet and inches as a string (6'9); null for most players.
weight_kgintegerWeight in kilograms; many players have none. Null on some rows.
weight_lbsintegerWeight in pounds; null for many players.
statuscharacterRegistration state of the player in the database: ACTIVE, INACTIVE or UNREGISTERED.
jersey_numbercharacterJersey number as a string. Present ONLY in the roster variant of /players (seasonId + teamId) and on /players/{playerId}; missing from the unfiltered list. Absent on some rows.
positioncharacterPlaying position (G, F, C, PG, SG, SF, PF, GF). Present ONLY in the roster variant of /players (seasonId + teamId) and on /players/{playerId}; missing from the unfiltered list. Absent on some rows.
organization_idcharacterDataCore organisation id: b1e0z (EASL).
created_atcharacterWhen the sync server inserted the row, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (a different format from updatedAt; zone unstated, UTC assumed).
updated_atcharacterWhen the sync server last synced the row, ISO 8601 with milliseconds and Z (UTC).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in easl_health().

See also

Other EASL Functions: easl_game(), easl_health(), easl_leaders(), easl_pbp(), easl_player(), easl_player_box(), easl_player_stats(), easl_schedule(), easl_seasons(), easl_standings(), easl_team(), easl_team_box(), easl_team_box_by_period(), easl_team_leaders(), easl_team_schedule(), easl_team_stats(), easl_teams()
